a = N
res_8 = []
while True:
    remainder = a % 8
    res_8.append(str(remainder))
   
    if a // 8 == 0:
        break
    a //= 8

ans_8 = "".join(reversed(res_8))


digits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
a = N
res_16 = []
while True:
    remainder = a % 16
    res_16.append(digits[remainder])  
    
    if a // 16 == 0:
        break
    a //= 16

ans_16 = "".join(reversed(res_16))

print(f"{ans_8} {ans_16}")
